text:
mike-partners: quick sync — we need a concrete plan for the multi-target connector bundle (Snowflake + Databricks + vector dbs) so marketplace listing, HW bundle SKU, and the certification lab schedule align. who can own the SKU mapping?
anya-gtm: i can own SKU mapping + pricing tier. planning to propose a single "Connector Suite" SKU and optional "HW Bundle" add-on. need eng to confirm install footprint for the HW add-on.
sylvia-eng: re: HW add-on — the onprem gateway requires 2x A100-equivalent for production load we tested. for marketplace listing we should state recommended min: 1xA40 + 1xCPU node for metadata. also need our installer to support delta-share and role mapping.
raj-arch: noted. can we list exact resource requirements per workload profile? small/med/large with token throughput targets. that'll help sales & hw partner sizing.
anya-gtm: yes — i'll draft a table. question: do we need separate SKUs for EU-residency vs global? partner wants one SKU but legal demands residency flag.
natalie-legal: from contracts side we prefer a single SKU with metadata tags: "eu-residency": true/false and a regional entitlements clause. that'll avoid duplicative SKUs while keeping compliance clear.
mike-partners: ok — single SKU + metadata tags. sylvia, can engineering produce an install matrix (min/recommended/opt) and a short smoke test script for cert lab? connector-bot: CI: nightly-integration passed 2024-04-10T08:12:34Z :white_check_mark:
sylvia-eng: i'll put together the install matrix and a smoke test matrix by EOD Thursday. sketch of smoke tests:
- ingest sample file into Snowflake stage -> run connector -> verify vector index created
- follow-on query latency < 200ms for 1k qps simulated
- role mapping test for cross-account access
- telemetry sanity (error rate < 0.1%)
mike-partners: perfect. can you include exact CLI commands so cert lab can run unattended? sample SQL for the snow stage would help too.
sylvia-eng: adding a small snippet now:
```
-- create stage
CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE test_stage url='s3://redwood-test' credentials=(aws_key_id='X' aws_secret_key='Y');
-- load small dataset
COPY INTO target_table FROM @test_stage/file.json FILE_FORMAT=(TYPE=JSON);
-- confirm rows
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_table;
```
anya-gtm: love it. we'll include that in the marketplace manifest as "smoke_test_commands" so partners can self-validate before booking formal cert.
raj-arch: reminder: telemetry sampling defaults to 0.5% for privacy. cert lab needs to validate telemetry tagging but not capture PII. add notes in runbook.
natalie-legal: confirm non-prod datasets only, and include redaction step. sample clause: "certification runs must use synthetic or anonymized datasets; logs must be scrubbed of PII prior to external sharing."
mike-partners: timeline check — GTM wants joint announcement week of May 6. That gives two weeks for cert lab runs and marketplace submission. realistic?
anya-gtm: tight but doable if cert lab slots are available. sylvia, can we run a prioritized smoke pass (happy path only) in 48 hours to unblock listing?
sylvia-eng: yes — we'll run a happy-path smoke run in 48h and share results. full matrix will take the 2 weeks.
connector-bot: cert-lab-scheduler: slot reserved for Redwood on 2024-04-16 09:00 UTC (2h) :calendar:
mike-partners: great. action items:
- anya: publish SKU + manifest metadata draft (tomorrow noon)
- sylvia: 48h happy-path smoke commands + install matrix (deliverables: CLI + SQL snippets)
- raj: resource sizing table for small/med/large
- natalie: finalize residency clause + redaction blurb
please add any blockers here.
anya-gtm: adding draft SKU page to the shared drive now. will ping once ready.
sylvia-eng: quick blocker — we still need Databricks connector connector version that supports Unity Catalog role mapping. pinging eng-ml team.
mike-partners: ok i'll loop in eng-ml separately. thanks all. :thumbsup:
